entries.german: Dyetraich Stauffer, Vitztum zu Sultzbach, gibt dem Friderich Kemnatter Brief über das Urteil des Landgerichts daselbst durch das ein von diesem vorgezeigter Brief mit 4 Siegeln für gültig erklärt wird, laut dessen Friderich Vogt von Rosenberg an Erhard den Lo{e}hleyn 2 Huben zu Ekkersuelt(1) zu freiem Eigen verkauft hatte. Nach Aussage des F. Kemnatter hatte der + Erhart Lo{e}hel die Gewere ersessen. Landgerichtssiegel.
entries.english: Dyetraich Stauffer, Vitztum of Sultzbach, gives Friderich Kemnatter a letter about the judgment of the local district court, declaring a letter with four seals presented by him to be valid, according to which Friderich Voit von Rosenberg had sold Erhard den Lo{e}hleyn two Huben in Ekkersuelt(1) as his own property. According to F. Kemnatter's statement, Erhart Lo{e}hleyn had acquired the property through possession. District court seal.

facts.content: sold two Huben at Ekkersuelt to Erhard den Loehleyn as free property.
acquired the two Huben at Ekkersuelt through possession, according to Friderich Kemnatter.
presented a letter with four seals, declared valid by the Landgericht at Sultzbach, concerning Friderich von Rosenberg’s sale of two Huben at Ekkersuelt.
